Privacy

How the website and macOS app handle your data.

This website

This static site adds no analytics, advertising, contact forms, or tracking cookies. Its hosting infrastructure processes connection information such as IP addresses and request details to deliver and protect the site.

The home page contacts GitHub's public API and public raw-file service to check for the latest release and matching Homebrew cask. GitHub receives ordinary request information, including your IP address. These requests omit browser credentials. Downloads and support links also take you to GitHub. Those services have their own privacy policies.

Local profiles and conversations

The app stores account profiles, local session metadata, usage readings, and backups on your Mac. Saved profiles contain sensitive login state. The switcher does not send profiles or conversations to Synesthetic Systems. It has no app analytics or advertising SDK.

Claude itself continues to communicate with Anthropic as usual. This policy describes Shannigans, not Claude's handling of your conversations.

Optional live usage checks

When you enable Live Usage, the app reads the chosen profile's encrypted Claude Desktop cookies, verifies its account and organization, and makes authenticated requests only to claude.ai to retrieve usage. These are full login cookies, not narrowly scoped usage tokens.

Decrypted credentials are kept in memory, not copied into a separate credential store or written to logs. The usage checker caches percentages, reset dates, and sanitized status locally. Turning Live Usage off stops these checks.

macOS may request access to Claude Safe Storage in your Keychain. Shannigans explains this before an interactive prompt. Background checks do not prompt. Enter your Keychain password only in the macOS dialog. Read about the permission choices.

Retention and removal

The default retention is five session backups. Saved login profiles are not backups and are not pruned by that setting.

Removing the app or uninstalling its Homebrew cask intentionally leaves profile and session data in place. Claude's active storage can link into this data; deleting it without disentangling those links could break Claude or erase sessions. There is currently no automatic profile-data cleanup. See removal guidance before changing these folders.

Support and questions

Support is available through GitHub issues. Issues are public. Please do not include cookies, account profile folders, passwords, account emails, or unredacted conversation logs. GitHub processes information you submit under its own policy.

For information about the developer, visit Synesthetic Systems LLC. Material changes to this policy will be reflected here with an updated date.
